usageNotes: Removes a subscription key from the PDM pool permanently. Before calling this, verify the key is not currently the live active key on any bound remote node — PDM will refuse the deletion if it is; use the Clear Key action on the Node Subscription Status panel first to deactivate it. If the key is assigned to a remote node, the caller must also hold PRIV_RESOURCE_MODIFY on that remote in addition to System.Modify.

examples.summary: Remove a Proxmox Backup Server community key from the pool

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the subscription key entry from the PDM pool; the key cannot be recovered through the API and must be re-added manually if needed.
tips: Pass the current config digest to guard against concurrent modifications — PDM will reject the request if another write has occurred since you last read the pool.
A null return on success means no body is returned; treat any non-2xx response as a failure.
If the delete is refused with a conflict error, check whether the key is still bound as the active key on a remote node and clear it there first.
